overlay:file-viewer-opened-from-file-exp.note: Editor: the desktop editor edits and saves through rsid (#113, #134): i a A I o O and the vim editor keys, Ctrl-S, :w (also on an unedited file, which rewrites it as the TUI does), :wq, :x, :w! force-save, :e! reload, :q refused while unsaved and :q! discarding, the TUI's changed-on-disk refusal "Save refused — file changed on disk: <path> (use :w! to overwrite or :e! to reload)" with a re-read that reports "Already up to date" when the buffer equals the disk and re-creates a deleted file, drafts kept per file with a dot in the tree, a Save button, a beforeunload guard; while editing the viewer's own lines are drawn from the buffer, so syntax colours (re-lexed as you type), the automatic bracket-match highlight, the git-gutter signs (carried over unsaved edits and refreshed after a save), the line numbers, search (/ ? with every hit lit incrementally, n N * #, in normal mode) and folds (za zo zc zM zR, regions re-derived from the buffer, the caret opens a fold it types in and steps over a closed one) all work; bracket auto-pairing as the TUI does it (brackets { ( [ only: an opener types the pair, a closer types over its closer, Backspace between an empty pair removes both; :set autopair / :set noautopair, on by default); Ctrl-V pastes the system clipboard at the caret from any mode, which is what the TUI's Ctrl-V does (its viewer has no visual-block mode, so there is none to add; Cmd-V pastes natively); a file with mixed line endings or a lone CR is edited (each unchanged line keeps its own break, a new line takes the break of the line above it) and CRLF files keep CRLF. Not here: a mouse drag does not select text (a click puts the caret; v / V select), and IME composition text shows once it is committed. Read-mode viewer: source navigation with a character cursor: h/l, w/b/e, W/B/E, 0/^/$, {/}, % and counts; j/k, gg/G/NG, Ctrl-d/u/f/b/e/y, PageUp/Down; search / and ? (incremental, every hit highlighted, Enter keeps it, Esc clears), n/N, * and # (viewer-model.ts findMatches/matchFrom, as file_viewer.rs); folds za/zo/zc/zM/zR with the ▸/▾ gutter, a '··· N lines' summary, cursor moves skip closed folds and a search hit or :N opens the fold hiding it (regions: multi-line bracket pairs and block comments outside strings, indentation for Python/YAML, fences and heading sections for Markdown, in place of tree-sitter nodes); syntax highlighting for the TUI's tree-sitter languages (Rust, Python, JS, TS/TSX, shell, JSON, TOML, YAML, Go, C, C++, Markdown) with its role colours; automatic bracket-match highlight; Space m renders .md through the sanitizing Markdown backend with j/k/Ctrl-d/u/f/b/gg/G scrolling and / ? n N marking hits in the rendered text; line numbers, git gutter, binary and truncated states; q / Space q / :q, Space e, Space Space, Backspace, :N, :e!. yy/yn/yr in the explorer copy a path

module:ui/overlay/telescope.rs.note: centered picker popup with matched characters highlighted

module:ui/file_renderer.rs.note: virtualized lines with git, fold and number gutters, syntax colours, search and current-hit marks, the cursor cell, the matching bracket, fold summaries and the Markdown preview

module:ui/treesitter.rs.note: tree-sitter is a native parser; the desktop lexes the same languages (the ui/treesitter.rs extension registry) with a small line lexer that carries block-comment, multi-line-string and fence state between lines, and derives fold regions from bracket pairs, block comments, indentation and Markdown sections in place of its foldable nodes (no new dependency)
